activation_mode.label: How recording starts
activation_mode.description: Press: start and stop with the button or widget; no hotkey is used. Hold: your compositor sends press and release for a shortcut you configure outside the plugin. Hold keyboard: the plugin watches a recording hotkey on a keyboard you select; set the combination in the Recording hotkey field below.

evdev_device.label: Keyboard for direct hold
evdev_device.description: Used only for direct keyboard hold, never for Toggle or compositor Hold. Select the keyboard to watch, not a microphone. Reading its keys requires explicit permission for that device.

evdev_chord.label: Recording hotkey
evdev_chord.description: Keyboard combination to hold while recording, for example Ctrl+Space. Empty means unassigned: nothing starts recording from the keyboard and no key is chosen for you. Keys are observed, not captured, so other applications still receive them.

language.label: Recognition language
language.description: Language expected in your speech. Auto detects it while transcribing and can be less stable for very short phrases.

device.label: Custom model device
device.description: Used only for a custom model. CPU-small always uses the processor; CUDA-turbo uses NVIDIA with available CUDA libraries.

model_profile.label: Recognition
model_profile.description: CPU-small uses the processor without NVIDIA. CUDA-turbo uses NVIDIA with CUDA. For a custom model, choose its folder and device in Advanced settings.

preload.label: Keep model ready in memory
preload.description: Load the recognition model at start and keep it after use. The first word appears faster, but memory stays in use while idle.

after_transcription.label: After dictation
after_transcription.description: What happens when you stop recording. Editor only: show the text. Clean or Prompt: also send the text to your LLM. Copy: also copy the text to the clipboard.

close_after_copy.label: Close editor after Copy
close_after_copy.description: Close the text window automatically when you press Copy.

history_enabled.label: Keep dictation history
history_enabled.description: Store the last 10 recognized texts on this computer. Disabled by default.

llm_base_url.label: LLM address (ending in /v1)
llm_base_url.description: Address of your OpenAI-compatible server, for example http://localhost:8080/v1. Needed only for Clean and Prompt.

llm_model.label: LLM model name
llm_model.description: Model identifier your server expects, for example qwen2.5:7b. Type it yourself when the server does not list models.

llm_api_key.label: LLM API key
llm_api_key.description: Stored openly in Noctalia settings.toml. Empty means no Authorization. Do not publish this file or its backups with a key.

show_advanced.label: Advanced settings
show_advanced.description: Show program/model paths, recognition hints, time limits and LLM instructions. Usually no changes are needed.

helper_path.label: voiceprompt-helper program
helper_path.description: Optional absolute helper path. Empty finds the standard VoicePrompt installation, then PATH.

custom_ct2_path.label: Local model folder
custom_ct2_path.description: Complete prepared CT2 model. Used only when Custom model is selected.

glossary.label: Recognition hints (terms)
glossary.description: Comma-separated names, terms or abbreviations that should be recognized correctly, for example product names.

idle_unload_seconds.label: Unload after idle (seconds)
idle_unload_seconds.description: How long the model may stay in memory unused before it is unloaded. 0 keeps it loaded.

model_load_timeout_seconds.label: Model load time limit (seconds)
model_load_timeout_seconds.description: Safety limit for loading the model before the attempt is given up.

final_timeout_seconds.label: Final recognition limit (seconds)
final_timeout_seconds.description: Safety limit for the final recognition after you stop recording.

clean_system_prompt.label: Clean instruction
clean_system_prompt.description: Instruction sent with the text for Clean. Editing it changes how Clean rewrites your dictation.

prompt_system_prompt.label: Prompt instruction
prompt_system_prompt.description: Instruction sent with the text for Prompt. Editing it changes how Prompt turns dictation into a task.

ui.degraded: Live updates slowed; final uses the complete recording.
ui.proposal: Result is a suggestion because the document changed.
ui.clean_hint: Clean: correct dictated text with the configured LLM
ui.prompt_hint: Prompt: turn this text into instructions with the configured LLM
ui.diagnostics_empty: Check the selected CPU or CUDA device with Diagnostics.
ui.cuda_install_hint: Install the CUDA extra in the helper environment, then check again. The plugin never installs system libraries.
ui.cuda_driver_hint: Check the NVIDIA driver and int8_float16 compute support.
ui.cuda_model_separate: CUDA libraries work. The selected local STT model loads only for recording or explicit keep-warm.
ui.error_cuda_unavailable: CUDA could not load. Open Setup and run Diagnostics for the missing libraries or driver.
ui.error_model_profile_mismatch: The selected model folder does not match the profile. Select the matching model or the custom profile.
ui.error_compute_type_unsupported: The GPU does not support the selected compute type. Check Diagnostics.
ui.error_inference_out_of_memory: Not enough memory for recognition. Close another GPU workload or explicitly select a smaller profile.
ui.error_hotkey_not_configured: Choose a real shortcut first; none is assigned.
ui.error_hotkey_invalid: Shortcut format is invalid. Example: Ctrl+Space.
ui.error_evdev_not_installed: The optional evdev package is required only for direct keyboard hold.
ui.error_evdev_access_denied: The selected keyboard cannot be read. Permissions were not changed.
ui.error_credential_invalid: The API key contains invalid characters or a line break.
ui.error_staging_token_invalid: The private data transfer expired. Retry the operation.
ui.error_timeout: The LLM did not finish within 120 seconds. Your text is unchanged; check the provider and retry.
ui.error_incomplete_response: The provider closed the connection before completing its response. Your text is unchanged.
ui.manual_model: Manual model ID works even when /models is unavailable.
ui.setup_description: Recording needs a helper, a prepared model and an available microphone. All VoicePrompt parameters, including the API key, are on its Noctalia settings page.
ui.hold_warning: Toggle and compositor Hold (`hold`) need no keyboard access. Direct keyboard hold (`hold-evdev`) is opt-in, requires permission for the selected keyboard, never assigns a key for you and does not suppress the key in other applications.
ui.microphone_settings_hint: VoicePrompt records from the system default microphone. Pick the source in Noctalia Audio → Input; More → Microphone opens that chooser. There is no separate microphone list here.
ui.llm_parameters_set: LLM parameters set; checked when Clean or Prompt is used.
ui.llm_not_connected: LLM not connected; dictation and Copy still work.
ui.error_helper_not_installed: Helper is missing. Use Install helper, then check again.
ui.error_helper_path_invalid: The helper override does not exist. Clear it or select an installed executable in Advanced settings.
ui.error_helper_diagnostics_timeout: Readiness check timed out. Try again.
ui.error_helper_diagnostics_invalid: Helper does not support this readiness report. Update the helper.
ui.error_installer_unavailable: Installer assets are missing. Run scripts/install.sh from the received VoicePrompt checkout.
ui.error_installer_launch_failed: Could not open the installation terminal.
ui.error_model_missing: The selected recognition model is missing. Download it explicitly.
ui.error_model_corrupt: The selected model is damaged. Download its managed copy again or select a valid custom model.
ui.error_model_checksum_mismatch: Model checksum failed. Download its managed copy again.
ui.error_configuration_invalid: Select a valid recognition profile and a prepared folder for a custom model.
ui.error_pipewire_unavailable: pw-record is missing. Install PipeWire tools for your distribution.
ui.error_pipewire_unreachable: The PipeWire microphone server is unreachable.
ui.error_pipewire_unverified: Could not verify the PipeWire server; readiness is not confirmed.
ui.error_cpu_runtime_unavailable: CPU recognition dependencies are unavailable. Reinstall the helper.
ui.error_vad_runtime_unavailable: Speech detection dependencies are unavailable. Reinstall the helper.
ui.error_text_too_large: Text exceeds 64 KiB in UTF-8. The paste was rejected; the current text was kept.
ui.error_history_not_loaded: History has not been loaded yet. Existing records will not be overwritten.
ui.error_helper_owner_replaced: Helper is reconnecting. The current text is kept and pending saves will resume after history loads.
